name: OpenSpotter Syringe Workflow
description: Editable event-hook workflow. The numeric planner owns safe lifecycle order; matching sections run in block and section order for each event.

custom_variables.name: syringe_mm_per_ul
custom_variables.label: Syringe travel per microliter
custom_variables.description: Plunger travel conversion used by the planner.

custom_variables.name: priming_speed_factor
custom_variables.label: Priming speed factor
custom_variables.description: Multiplier applied to dispensing speed while removing backlash.

custom_variables.name: x_homing_clearance_z
custom_variables.label: X homing clearance Z
custom_variables.description: Safe Z height used before homing X.

custom_variables.name: spiral_resolution_radians
custom_variables.label: Spiral angular resolution
custom_variables.description: Angular step used by the spiral path planner.

sections.name: Machine setup and needle calibration
sections.template:
G90 ;use absolute coordinates
G21 ;unit mm
NEEDLE_TIP_OFFSETS_DISABLE ; Homing and mesh use machine/probe coordinates

;Homing sequence
M117 Gantry Align
G28 Z0 ;Home Z
G28 Y0 ;Home Y
G0 Z{{custom.x_homing_clearance_z}} F{{global.adcent_speed}};Move to X Homing position
G28 X0 ;Home X
G0 X{{global.probe_x}} Y{{global.probe_y}} F{{global.movement_speed}} ; Go with Head to probe position
SET_TMC_FIELD STEPPER=stepper_z FIELD=SGT VALUE=0
G0 Z{{global.probe_ram_height}} F{{global.probe_feed_rate}} ; Ram into top
G0 Z{{global.probe_return_height}} F{{global.probe_feed_rate}} ; Back down
SET_TMC_FIELD STEPPER=stepper_z FIELD=SGT VALUE=4
G28 Z0; Home Z again
G28 Z0; Home Z again
M117 Aligned
MESH X_MIN={{acceptance.x_left:.3f}} X_MAX={{acceptance.x_right:.3f}} Y_MIN={{acceptance.y_bottom:.3f}} Y_MAX={{acceptance.y_top:.3f}} POINTS={{global.mesh_points}} ;Home Z with mesh bed leveling inside acceptance square
NEEDLE_TIP_OFFSETS_ENABLE ; Apply saved TCP offsets plus live needle Z trim to normal moves
G0 X{{global.probe_x}} Y{{global.probe_y}} F{{global.movement_speed}}; Go with probe above vacuum chuck
HOME_SYRINGE
DISPENSE MM=0
G1 Z{{global.calibration_height}} F{{global.calibration_feed_rate}}
M117 ;Calibrate Needle to touch substrate
PAUSE
G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}}

sections.name: Anchor calibration
sections.template:
; Anchor Calibration Sequence
G0 X{{runtime.anchor.x}} Y{{runtime.anchor.y}} F{{global.movement_speed}} ; Move to anchor position
G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_low}} F{{global.decent_speed}} ; Lower needle to calibration height
WAIT S={{global.calibration_wait}} ; Wait at calibration position
G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}} ; Raise needle to safe height
; Calibration complete

sections.name: Move to reload safe height
sections.template: G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}}

sections.name: Dynamic refill diagnostics
sections.template: ; Dynamic refill: {{runtime.refill.target_fill_mm:.3f}} mm ({{runtime.refill.target_fill_ul:.3f}} uL) [spots={{runtime.refill.remaining_spots_mm:.3f}} mm + cleaning={{runtime.refill.cleaning_mm:.3f}} mm + reserve={{runtime.refill.reserve_mm:.3f}} mm = {{runtime.refill.total_needed_mm:.3f}} mm, cap={{runtime.refill.cap_mm:.3f}} mm]

sections.name: Container aspiration and priming
Grid header
sections.template: M117; Main Grid {{grid.name}}

sections.name: Move to grid spot
sections.template:
G0 X{{runtime.spot.x}} Y{{runtime.spot.y}} F{{global.movement_speed}}
G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_low}} F{{global.decent_speed}}

sections.name: Stabilize at row start
sections.template: WAIT S={{global.row_start_wait}}

sections.name: Dispense and contact grid spot
Spiral header
sections.template:
; Spiral sequence
M117; Spiral {{spiral.spiral_mode}}

sections.name: Spiral droplet
Continuous spiral segment
Cleaning header
sections.template:
; Create cleaning sequence
M117; Auto Cleaning

sections.name: Move to cleaning spot
sections.template:
G0 X{{runtime.spot.x}} Y{{runtime.spot.y}} F{{global.movement_speed}}
G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_low}} F{{global.decent_speed}}

sections.name: Stabilize cleaning row
sections.template: WAIT S={{global.row_start_wait}}

sections.name: Dispense cleaning spot
Begin washing
Washing stroke
sections.template:
G0 X{{runtime.washing.x_end}} F{{washing.washing_speed}}
G0 X{{runtime.washing.x_start}} F{{washing.washing_speed}}

sections.name: Finish washing
sections.template: G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}}

sections.name: Empty syringe
Rinse aspiration and dispense
Rinse midpoint
sections.template:
WAIT S={{global.rinse_final_wait}}

G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}} ; dispensing leftovers

sections.name: Final rinse wait
sections.template: WAIT S={{global.rinse_final_wait}}

sections.name: Raise after emptying
sections.template: G0 Z{{global.z_movement_pos_high}} F{{global.adcent_speed}}

sections.name: Present build plate
sections.template:
G90 ;absolute positioning
G0 Y{{global.present_plate_y}} F{{global.present_plate_speed}};present print
NEEDLE_TIP_OFFSETS_DISABLE ; Return later manual moves to machine coordinates
